Excellent Japanese BBQ experience
Apr 2019 • Solo
This is a new venue in a small but expanding chain of Sumo BBQ restaurants. You can see the others on the website, I'm sure they are all similar. A modern style Japanese BBQ with stylish black tables and seating, with a circular recess in the middle of each table to accommodate the hot charcoals. You choose a selection of cut meats and seafood which they serve raw on a platter, attentive staff then fuss around and put pieces of meat and seafood on the barbecue for you, turning it and taking it off when cooked - or you can do it yourself, BBQ is not rocket science. I had the set platter of seafood and set platter of meat, but you can go a-la-carte if you want. Absolutely delicious, thoroughly enjoyed everything. I initially ordered a thirst quenching "sake sangria" a strange fusion concept but wow, you really should try it! You don't realise from the photo in the menu just how big it is - comes in a huge glass with a straw! After that I switched to more traditional hot sake which was a perfect match to the BBQ. At 1,030,000 Dong (including drinks) this was my most expensive meal in Vietnam, but totally satisfying and great value for money in my book.
